aggregation: frame arithmetic mean within sequence; equal arithmetic mean over all 14 sequence means

metric_contract.LPIPS_AlexNet_input: repeat the grayscale [0,1] prediction and reference into 3 channels, then map linearly to [-1,1] for the pinned PerceptualSimilarity AlexNet network
metric_contract.PSNR_input: native grayscale float32 [0,1], data_range=1; exact match is +infinity
metric_contract.aggregation: arithmetic mean over evaluated frames within each sequence; then equal arithmetic mean over all 14 sequences
metric_contract.evaluated_endpoint_set: all retained, strictly increasing HQF event endpoints after the first image boundary (indices 1..N-1) in each of the 14 sequences; the first image has no preceding event window and is excluded from model input and metrics; no output-selected frame subset
metric_contract.model_output_and_reference_range: float32 [0,1] on the same native grayscale pixel grid
metric_contract.prediction_mapping: clip the raw E2VID grayscale output to [0,1] once before metrics and preview export; no per-frame min-max, brightness fit, or histogram fit
metric_contract.raw_model_output_recording: retain finite raw min/max for audit; metrics use a deterministic clamp to [0,1]
metric_contract.sequence_weights: equal; never proportional to frame count

metric_provenance.metric_loop: unchanged score_pair, isolated module run identities supplied by Stage9 bridge

safety_note: Real scores, when present, are report-only and must not be used to tune generators, training, scenes, or select checkpoints.
